## Authorized work

Revise the accepted SCI-MAP v0.2/r0.1 architecture without a new broad MAP
derivation. Preserve all 52 requirement and 25 prediction identities, one
shared normative core, ordinary MAP/coadd science, exact imported boundaries,
and existing claim ceilings. Amend existing subjects to:

1. use the exact ordered MAP lifecycle
   `requested/effective/observation_resolved/applied/realized`;
2. define six independently requestable observation/coadd roles with exact
   base parents and role-qualified response/covariance dependencies;
3. require a complete exact common comparison space and both row maps before
   every full-procedure numerical difference;
4. make MAP wording congruent with current restricted SCI-NOI authority;
5. separate ECS requirement results from evidence-artifact realization;
6. bind exact product/notation identities, remove undefined publication `q`,
   reserve `K_p` for response, and use `bold Sigma^obs` for coadd covariance;
7. type the above-one coverage-cut override and add small-N fixtures; and
8. define one exact finite WCS representation-comparison population, metric,
   frame, generation, precision, bound, and invalid-point rule.

Return complete source/profile/boundary/role/VAL records, crosswalks,
machine-readable templates, semantic/parity records, and a proposed owner
acceptance/freeze disposition. Exact mechanical covers, build, PDF QA,
manifests, archive, import/commit, and exact-SHA review are manager-owned.
